data.one_liner: Flutter widget showcase and isolated preview tool
data.what_it_does: Storybook Toolkit lets you build and preview widgets in isolation, with device frames and theme switching. It also supports golden tests and plugin extensibility.
use_when: Need to showcase or test widgets in isolation
Want to generate golden tests for UI components
Need to preview widgets on multiple device frames
Looking for a plugin-based devtool for Flutter
avoid_when: You only need a simple widget library without preview features
Your project already uses a different storybook implementation
strengths: Plugin architecture allows adding features easily
